intro.text: A wooden tavern in the warcamps on the Shattered Plains.

description.text: It is built against a bigger stone building, on its leeward side, and is lit by firelight, since drunk customers might pocket spheres. The main room is packed, smoky and loud; private dining rooms down a back hallway mostly serve rich merchants. Wines and lavis ale are popular, but it refuses Horneater lager, which melts its cups.

items.text: Once released from bridge duty, Kaladin's bridgemen often drank there. It was a favourite of Moash and above all of Peet, who was smitten with a barmaid named Ka, though Rock preferred taverns that served Horneater lager.
Graves and his associates met Moash and Kaladin in one of its private rooms to talk about King Elhokar.
